**STEP 6 - Grams:** Cut fruit has a bulk density of about 0.6 g/ml, so 50 ml × 0.6 ≈ 30 g. A half kiwi typically weighs closer to 40–50 g, so I'll use about 40 g as a more realistic figure.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Raw green kiwi (flesh and skin) is about 61 kcal per 100 g. 40 g × 0.61 ≈ 24 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** A half kiwi is about 40–50 g and about 25 kcal, which is plausible for one small fruit half on a 20 cm plate.
